findings.note: The central T-003 implementation artifact is not included in the bundle. Only substring-based tests and reports are provided, so the actual Risk-Upgrade Gate procedure cannot be reviewed for complete, correctly ordered, fail-closed behavior.

The acceptance tests do not execute A2 evaluate-predicate or verify the required Capability × Project-Context-component fan-out. They substitute component-name equality and manually assemble the fragment, while the bundle's CHANGELOG states evaluate-predicate is implemented. Consequently the core REQ-005 signal-source integration can be absent or incorrect while all 14 assertions pass.

The verification contract records regression passes:true, but its cited evidence explicitly reports a real repository-release-validation failure and states that passes is therefore false. This makes the default-fail contract inconsistent with its own evidence.

findings.note: The protected publication contract remains internally inconsistent: TEST-010 widens the payload to five targets including .github/workflows/test.yml, while TEST-031 and design.md still require an exact four-target set. The runner therefore cannot both enforce the stated exact set and apply T-003's staged CI candidate as tasks.md requires.
